73: Display the CPU load, GPU load, and virtual memory usage at the top of the screen. CPU and GPU loads are presented as the time that it takes to calculate or draw each frame, respectively. The percentages represent how long it takes to calculate or draw each frame relative to the target frame rate, which is 60 frames/second for the GPU and 60 ticks/second (or 180 ticks/second with fast-forward enabled) for the CPU. >100% load means the game will run slower than the target frame rate.
74: Toggle whether motion blur is rendered for all moving objects.
75: Reduce the size of very large (images with >= 1 million pixels) or all graphics to half their dimensions. UI sprites are excluded. (Not recommended for high-resolution displays, but may be used to free up memory. Requires game restart.)
76: Defer the loading of certain images so that they are loaded when they are needed instead of loading them when the game is first opened. This will result in a quicker launch time and lower VRAM usage, but you may experience pop-in as sprites are being loaded. Recommended for systems with low VRAM. (Requires game restart.)
77: Draw the background haze when in flight.
78: Draw the background starfield when in flight.
79: Draw the background starfield with a fixed zoom level instead of changing with the view zoom level.
80: Add parallax to objects in the background, which includes the haze and starfield.
84: Animate the background stars and haze in the main menu.
85: Create a white flash when hyperspacing between systems.
86: Add additional motion blur to the background when jumping between systems. The medium and heavy options control how intense the effect is.
87: Controls the display of your fleet ship icons when in the shipyard or outfitter.
88: - "fancy": applies a sobel filter to all ships. This can result in high GPU load for large fleets and/or on low performance computers.
90: Controls the display of your flagship and target ship icons in the HUD.
91: - "fancy": applies a sobel filter to the sprites. This can result in high GPU load for some ships on very old or low performance computers.
93: Controls the display of cloaked escorts.
94: - "fancy": causes the ship to become transparent and applies a red outline.
95: - "fast": simply shifts the ship to being red.
96: Choose the interpolation method used when sampling textures. (Requires game restart.)
99: Display status overlays over top of all ships when in flight. Status overlays display a ship's shields and hull.
102: - "damaged": overlays only appear on ships that have taken damage.
103: - "on hit": overlays appear for a short time on ships that have just taken damage.
104: - "--": this setting is broken down by ship category in the sub-settings below.
